info.title: E-commerce Platform API
info.description: Versioned REST API for catalog, customer accounts, carts, checkout, orders, payments, shipping, inventory, promotions, settings, and webhooks. Legacy /api routes are not registered; use /api/v1 only.

post.description: Bosta credentials are verified through the configured Authorization header before event processing.
Kashier signature verification is performed from the signed event payload.

parameters.name: X-Paymob-Hmac
parameters.description: Paymob HMAC. Alternative to the hmac query parameter.

post.description: Paymob HMAC is accepted through the hmac query parameter or X-Paymob-Hmac header. The signature must be valid.

bearerAuth.description: Send the authenticated API token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

CheckoutRequest.description: For authenticated checkout use address_id. For guest checkout provide items and guest details when checkout.require_authentication is false.

x-webhook-processing.description: Webhook processing is intentionally ordered to prevent unauthenticated, duplicate, or invalid events from changing business state.
